Future
studies
to
discover
more
about
the
effects
of
captivity
on
the
activity
of

yellowfin
tuna
will
be
important
to
understanding
the
tuna
response
and
optimizing

captive
conditions
to
best
maintain
tuna
in
captivity .
A
closer
look
at
tailbeat
frequency

and
amplitude
may
reveal
interesting
patterns
and
may
show
how
tuna
use
their
muscle
in

a
more
quantitative
fashion .
It
would
be
interesting
to
continue
speed
observations

throughout
the
year
to
investigate
the
possibility
of
seasonal
variation ,
as
well
as
to

observe
speed
at
different
water
temperatures
to
ascertain
the
magnitude
of
temperature

effects .
The
TRCC
fish
do
occasionally
sprint
around
the
tank ,
and
their
maximum
speed

is
not
known
nor
is
the
frequency
of
this
behavior .
